Shows highways, waterways between ports, administrative divisions (provinces, counties, and capitals of fiefs). Alternative title inferred from OPAC of National Diet Library, May 1, 2020. Relief shown pictorially. Oriented with north toward the upper right. Provides values for latitude but not longitude. Wood block print. Includes table of distances from Edo [i.e. Tokyo] to other places. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy imperfect: Torn at fold lines.
